dedupe_keys.name: lacosrep upper east ghana small reservoir inventory ifad lacosrep i and ii

description: This inventory characterises small reservoirs in Ghana's Upper East Region studied under the IFAD-funded LACOSREP projects, LACOSREP I (1992-1997) and LACOSREP II (2000-2006). The Ghana Irrigation Development Authority and IFAD compiled the dam data, and the two Excel files were deposited on Harvard Dataverse in 2015, available as a free download. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): custom dataset terms (Harvard Dataverse custom licence). Coverage is regional for one region's small reservoirs. Caveats: the page gives no field list or coordinates description, the data date from project periods up to 2006, and small reservoirs change quickly through siltation and repairs. Simulation uses: small reservoir storage and irrigation supply for capacity planning and drought adaptation in the Volta basin. Related records: Global Dam Watch (data-global-dam-watch-database) and GeoDAR (data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs).
